capital.evidence_quote: Tirana is the capital and largest city of the Republic of Albania

currency.evidence_quote: The Albanian Lek (ALL) is the official currency of Albania

timezone.evidence_quote: Albania observes Central European Time UTC+1 and Central European Summer Time UTC+2

voltage.evidence_quote: The low voltage distribution grid in Albania operates at 230V single phase

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Grid frequency across Albania is synchronized with continental Europe at 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Standard electrical sockets in Albania are European Type C and Type F Schuko

police.evidence_quote: State police emergency response line in Albania is 129

ambulance.evidence_quote: Emergency medical ambulance rescue operates on hotline 127

fire.evidence_quote: Fire and rescue services across Albania respond on 128

general.evidence_quote: Unified emergency number 112 connects directly to all emergency response dispatches

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Tourist police units operate through State Police dispatch 129 in resort regions

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Albania mobile download speeds average 58.2 Mbps across Vodafone and One Albania

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Fixed broadband speed in Albania averages 52.1 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: eSIM is supported by Vodafone Albania and One Albania. Prepaid tourist SIM packages (often offering generous 30GB-100GB data) are sold at Tirana Airport with passport registration.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: SIM registration requires valid passport verification under AKEP telecommunication rules

religion.evidence_quote: Albania is internationally celebrated for exemplary religious harmony and tolerance

festivals.value: Bağımsızlık ve Bayrak Günü (28 Kasım), Kurtuluş Günü (29 Kasım), Yaz Günü (Dita e Verës, 14 Mart), Nevruz
festivals.evidence_quote: Flag Day on November 28 and Summer Day on March 14 are beloved national holidays

legal_cultural_warnings.value: 'Besa' (onur ve söz verme yemini) geleneksel Arnavut misafirperverliğinin temelidir. Birçok küçük işletmede nakit para (Arnavut Leki veya Euro) tercih edilir. Prizler Avrupa standardı Tip C ve F'dir (230V).
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Hospitality and the ancient code of Besa guide relations with guests; cash remains widely used

tipping.value: Restoranlarda %10 bahşiş bırakmak yaygın ve takdir edilen bir gelenektir. Kafelerde bozuk para bırakmak uygundur.
tipping.evidence_quote: Tipping roughly 10 percent in restaurants is standard practice and warmly appreciated
